QuestInfo.0: Anthony, the vice president, with a strange expression has a favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Anthony is planning to ask for Albert's resignation for not performing his duties in regards to the Gabrielle Kidnap.  Anthony wants you to post the petition for Albert's removal at the #bEdelstein Message Board#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have posted the petition on Albert to the town message board as Anthony has requested.

0.0: Tell me honestly, what do you think of the fair city of Edelstein? \r\n#L0##bUh...It's great?#l\n#k
0.1: I hear the hesitation in your voice. You must be as displeased as I am about the council president's recent mishandling of the Gabrielle kidnapping incident. \r\n#L0##bNot really.#l\n#k
0.2: We cannot sit idly by after Albert's failure. We must petition for his resignation! Will you take political arms, for the good of the city?

yes.0: Good! Post this #r#t4033837##k on the #bEdelstein Message Board#k. Don't tell anyone I told you to do it, or people might get the wrong idea and think that I want to be council president, which is really neither here nor there.

no.0: When I'm council president, I'm kicking you out!

1.0: Did you post the message? Now we wait for the good people of Edelstein to make the right choice.
